title: MSFS 2024 | Are Bridges FINALLY Fixed? Hobart Tasmania Photogrammetry (World Update 21)
description:
We’re heading down under to Tasmania in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 to check out the massive improvements in World Update 21! 🇦🇺

Flying low over Hobart, I wanted to see if the notorious "solid bridge" bug has been resolved—and the results are impressive. From the detailed colonial buildings to the improved maritime traffic in the harbor, the level of realism here is exactly what we were hoping for in the new engine.

In this video:
- Exploring Hobart, Tasmania's photogrammetry.
- Testing bridge fixes (Flying under them!).
- Checking out new 3D ship models and harbor details.
- Performance and loading time impressions.
